figmaRevisionPolicy.reason: The read-only connector used during F0 preparation does not expose the official file revision. The serial writer must read a fresh revision after the previous family transaction; no local packet may forge it.

routeFamily.dispatchPolicy: All eight routes resolve through W3 INTEGRATION_MAP to sourceSwitchV2 before the render-runtime switch.
routeFamily.fallbackPolicy: All eight render-runtime switch fallbacks fail loudly; the legacy flowScreen implementation also throws and cannot render source-switch.

r2aInstrumentation.readerContinuityPolicy: The 17 Reader controls visible in each of eight routes are instrumented through ReaderRuntimeContract.instrumentDom against the nested visualContextRoute. They retain reader-runtime ownership and are not duplicated as source-switch declarations.
r2aInstrumentation.identityPolicy: Candidate identity comes only from fixture sourceId business keys; source display name, index, selector, ordinal and DOM position are prohibited.
r2aInstrumentation.unknownIdentityPolicy: Fail closed; an unknown route/settingsKey or missing candidate sourceId emits no controlKey and the renderer rejects an unstable candidate.

guards: duplicate async start is rejected while pendingKind is non-null
completion is accepted only for the current requestId and pending kind
CANCEL clears requestId/pendingKind so later completion resolves stale
current, unavailable, disabled and unknown source selections are rejected
source-switch does not become the owner of Book Detail state

originRecovery.rootCauseFixed: The old sourceSwitchOriginRoute accepted Reader routes only, so book-detail/book-detail-toc-preview/book-directory lost their real navigation origin and exact trigger identity.
originRecovery.newContract: navigationOriginRoute, visualContextRoute and originControlKey are independent fields.
originRecovery.cancel: Returns to the exact navigation origin and restores focus by exact data-control-key; direct entry safely replaces to reader.
originRecovery.successfulNoTocCommit: Normalizes the existing Book Detail owner to normal and returns to the original detail/directory route; source-switch does not own or redefine Book Detail flow.

ariaAndFocus.candidateCollection: role=listbox with 11 native button role=option descendants
ariaAndFocus.selection: aria-selected reflects selectedSourceId; current/unavailable candidates expose aria-disabled and disabled
ariaAndFocus.loading: role=status, aria-live=polite and aria-busy=true; cancel remains enabled
ariaAndFocus.rollback: role=dialog, aria-modal=true; safe cancel owns deterministic initial focus
ariaAndFocus.focusReturn: Exact origin data-control-key, not a generic data-route selector
ariaAndFocus.hitTargets: Candidate rows and close control have interaction hosts of at least 44x44 CSS pixels
ariaAndFocus.alignment: Source name remains leading; latency/latest chapter and trailing controls remain right-side columns.

identityDistribution.note: The 22 candidate rows in source-switch/source-switch-results migrated from role=button articles to native buttons; the 3,808 semantic denominator is unchanged.

figmaReadOnlyBaseline.knownStructuralGap: The responsive masters are raw frames with INSTANCE=0. The writer must replace raw internals through canonical SourceSwitch component instances while preserving downstream instances and existing prototype reaction layers.
figmaReadOnlyBaseline.prototypeReactionPolicy: Preserve the 42 existing transparent Source Switch hit-layer reactions and the Book Detail entry reactions; retarget only after the local UiEvent owner is accepted.

figmaDecisionsRequired: Add a Selected state to SourceSwitch/CandidateRow while preserving Default/Hover/Pressed/Focus/Disabled/Loading and at least 44x44 hit targets.
Update CandidateList, CloseButton, WindowHeader and Window before any page master; trailing values/actions are right-aligned.
Add Phone and Tablet overlay variants only; landscape inherits Tablet and no Compact/Fold structure may be created.
Repair Page/Source Switch masters to real canonical instances, then let Page 23 downstream instances inherit; no detached frame or screenshot replacement.
Represent empty/error/timeout/loading/rollback/preview through canonical state components or explicit traceable page exceptions.
Preserve the Reader backdrop and all existing reactions; do not change UiEvent, state owner, async contract or Book Detail business flow in Figma.
